# Flags PrismML llama.cpp's llama-server accepts that the launcher does not
# use on a PrismML launch, and that mainline build 10902 no longer accepts,
# so unexposed_flags_mainline.txt cannot carry them. A flag that list
# already carries is not repeated here.
# --load-mode dio and mmap cover --direct-io and --mmap. --rpc is what the
# RPC pool launch appends directly; the mainline fixture image is built
# without RPC, so the structural table cannot name it.
--direct-io
--mmap
--no-direct-io
--rpc
-dio
-ndio
